id:

You will live a character's financial life: work, pay living costs, face surprises, and grow money through investing.

All money here is VIRTUAL. This is an educational simulation, not financial advice.

id:

Setelah selesai mengatur keuangan, tekan "Lanjut ke Bulan Berikutnya". Pasar bergerak dan laporan bulananmu muncul.
en:
At the start of each month your salary arrives and living costs are deducted. Sometimes an event needs your decision.

When you're done, tap "Next Month". The market moves and your monthly report appears.

id:
Pilih makan dan tempat tinggal. Yang murah membuat tabungan cepat bertambah, tapi bisa menurunkan kesehatan dan kebahagiaan.

Siapkan dana darurat (3-6 kali pengeluaran bulanan) untuk menghadapi sakit, PHK, atau kerusakan.
en:
Choose food and housing. Cheap options grow savings faster but can lower health and happiness.

Build an emergency fund (3-6x monthly spending) for sickness, layoffs, or repairs.

id:
Awalnya hanya tabungan, deposito, dan reksa dana pasar uang yang terbuka. Reksa dana saham, saham, lalu kripto terbuka bertahap saat kamu memenuhi syaratnya.

Ingat: semakin tinggi potensi untung, semakin tinggi risikonya.
en:
At first only savings, deposits, and money market funds are open. Equity funds, stocks, then crypto unlock as you meet requirements.

Remember: higher potential return means higher risk.
